features.heading: Features to grow
features.item0desc: No artificial limits. Add, reorder and edit as many links as you need at any time.

features.item2desc: Colours, fonts, backgrounds and layouts. Your page, your identity. No generic templates or creative limits.
features.item3desc: Your page is automatically listed in the public Catalog — ordered by acquisition number. More visibility with no effort.
features.item4desc: USD$37 per year, no surprises. No tiered subscriptions or hidden costs.
features.item5desc: Your data is yours. We never sell information to third parties. No hidden trackers. Ever.
